# kcore_postgresql (Data Source)

Read one PostgreSQL database.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kcore_postgresql" "app" {
  name = "app"
}

output "database_node" {
  value = data.kcore_postgresql.app.node_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `database` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_id` (String)
- `package` (String)
- `port` (Number)
